hero.lead: Hi, I am Davide. I design and build end-to-end web products, integrating AI into web apps and business workflows to deliver measurable value.

about.title: About me
about.text: I support projects end to end, from initial business needs to final delivery, choosing the right technologies and solutions for each context. My focus is integrating AI into web products and business workflows in a practical way, with a clear objective: to create added value for the product through better operations, decision-making, and measurable outcomes.

projects.title: Selected projects
projects.subtitle: Choose a strategic scenario and start a focused AI discussion with me.

items.title: AI Integration for Business Workflows
items.description: A strategic discussion for companies that want to reduce manual work, improve internal processes, and introduce AI where it creates concrete operational value.

items.title: Custom Web Platform & Product Architecture
items.description: A scenario for teams that need a custom digital product built around their real business context, with strong architecture, scalable delivery, and the right technology choices from day one.

items.title: Connected Ecosystems & Third-Party Services
items.description: A discussion for products that need to connect external APIs, data sources, payment flows, or business services into one reliable digital experience across web and mobile.

skills.title: Skills
skills.text: I've worked on very different projects — startups, enterprise products, complex integrations — and each context pushed me to expand my stack and adopt new approaches. What you find here is the result of years of real work, not just certifications.

approach.title: How I work
approach.text: I never stick to a single technology. I choose the stack based on the problem: sometimes a solid monolith is the right call, other times a serverless architecture that scales on its own. What stays constant is attention to code quality, maintainability, and clear APIs. In recent years I've integrated AI into real web products — not as a buzzword, but to automate processes, improve user experience, and reduce repetitive work.

cloud.title: Cloud & Serverless
cloud.text: I increasingly work on cloud-native architectures: serverless functions for lightweight and scalable logic, edge functions to reduce latency, and managed services to avoid reinventing infrastructure. I have experience with AWS, Azure environments, and platforms like Vercel and Netlify that simplify deployment without sacrificing control.

team.title: Team leadership & prioritization
team.text: I can coordinate work across multiple people, keep tasks clearly distributed, and keep the project aligned with its goals. I pay close attention to prioritization to avoid blockers, protect deadlines, and deliver within the expected timeframe.

focus.title: On-time delivery
focus.text: I organize tasks, dependencies, and check-ins so the project keeps moving steadily without losing quality along the way.

experiences.title: Experience
experiences.text: A product-focused background combining business applications, APIs, automation, and team coordination.

workStyle.title: How I work
workStyle.text: I combine AI integration, API design, OOP, design patterns, clean architecture, and testing to build robust applications. I also care a lot about problem solving, UX, and workflow automation.

experience.title: Recent experience
experience.text: From business applications to project coordination, my background combines technical execution, third-party integrations, and continuous improvement of internal tools.

skills.title: Technical skills
skills.text: These are the technologies and methods I use day to day, organized from real project experience.

Integrated listing, selection, and payment flows into the Ionic/Angular mobile app.
Built Odoo modules for clients using Python.
